Hydra — Login Testing Tool

← Wireshark Home Next → Brute Force

What Hydra Does

Hydra is a tool used to test login systems by automatically trying many username and password combinations.

Wordlists

A wordlist is a file containing possible passwords. Hydra uses this list to attempt logins systematically.

Example Command

hydra -l admin -P rockyou.txt ssh://192.168.1.50

This tests the username "admin" against a password list on an SSH service.

Ethics

Using Hydra without permission is illegal. Organizations protect against it using MFA, account lockouts, and rate limiting.
